title: Domain availability / RDAP output
description: One dataset item per domain (verdict + method + registrar), plus SUMMARY/OUTPUT JSON and optional TABLE.md in the default key-value store.

results.title: Availability results
results.description: Default dataset items, one per domain: domain, verdict (available|registered|unknown), method (RDAP|DNS|WHOIS), registrar, status, errors, durationMs. Views: overview.

summary.title: SUMMARY report
summary.description: Key-value store record SUMMARY (JSON): counts by verdict, charged, durationSecs, peakMemoryMb.

output.title: Run summary (OUTPUT)
output.description: Key-value store record OUTPUT (JSON): same run summary as SUMMARY plus charged event counts.

table.title: Markdown table (optional)
table.description: Key-value store record TABLE.md when writeMarkdownTable is enabled.
